review.accept_failed: The row could not be accepted. Nothing changed.
review.reject_failed: The row could not be rejected. Nothing changed.
review.reject_description: The reason is stored with the verdict and read by whoever wrote the row.
review.reject_reason_required: Say why — a rejection without a reason is not reviewable.
review.keyboard_hint: j / k move · x selects · a accepts · r rejects

review.empty_filtered: No pending rows in this ledger.
review.overwrite_description: An agent wrote this row. The reason is what makes the overwrite rate mean something.
review.overwrite_failed: The change was refused again. Nothing was saved.
